newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler estimates Q1 production up 4.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler estimates Q1 production up 4.7 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Friday it estimates its 1997 first quarter car and truck production will increase by about 4.7 percent over the same period a year ago.
Production of vehicles worldwide in the first quarter is estimated at 777,800 cars and trucks, up from 743,200 made in the same period last year, Chrysler said in a quarterly statement.
Chrysler said first quarter North American car production is estimated at 224,700 units, up from 207,300 made last year.
North American truck production is estimated to rise to 527,900 units from 514,400 made in the 1996 first quarter.
